implementation_refinement: Use one shared Gleam domain module for candidate/input-bound evidence states and metric availability; keep arbitrary strings, document existence and caller Booleans outside authority.

Opaque checked receipt values require a controlled observer/validator of actual receipt bytes, identity, freshness and source inputs. A smart constructor or matching digest alone is not runtime execution proof.
Preserve catalog/history claims as explicitly attributed metadata; no-argument verification wrappers lack current evidence and must report UNRUN.
Expose unavailable metrics and missing denominators as typed absence. Do not invent replacement quality scores; full metric algebra/formal obligations remain M01-M08.
Wire the CLI, actual Mist API handler, page accordion and shared checklist evaluator to the same decision. Preserve erlang:halt exit propagation already implemented.
Remove canonical-root fallback from candidate-sensitive FFI; bind the selected workspace explicitly and test a missing-file candidate while the canonical file still exists.

Extend the E03 owned file set to the actual web/checklist call paths and necessary shared module/tests; this is required by the existing acceptance clause, not permission to rewrite unrelated presentation.

Mutate actual production inputs: remove runtime/formal bytes, change candidate/source/input digest, use stale receipts, retain files and token/parity claims, alter measured inputs. Each applicable admission must be lost.
Keep E02 adapter observation separate from expected assertions; verification.evaluate must invoke production Gleam, never reinstate the rejected OCaml test-only evaluator.
